env-split-pane-pane.report: SplitPane's panes have no data-pane: give each SplitPane.Pane a className of your own, or select the first as .env-split-pane > .env-split-pane-pane:first-child.

env-split-pane.report: SplitPane sets no data-resizing while dragging: the handle has data-dragging, so write .env-split-pane:has(> .env-split-pane-handle[data-dragging]).
